tieu_de: Snr/Lead Data Engineer Pyspark, Snowflake - BONUS
dia_chi_raw: Hybrid, Floor 13, MB Sunny Tower, 259 Tran Hung Dao
mo_ta_cong_viec:
EPAM Vietnam is seeking an experienced Senior Data Software Engineer to play a key role in evolving our data platform. In this position, you will not only design and build high‑quality platform components in Python, but also take ownership of daily operations while troubleshooting complex data challenges. To succeed in this role, you will bring deep expertise in Azure, Databricks and DataOps, including hands‑on experience with Terraform and CI/CD, enabling you to deliver reliable, scalable and future‑ready data solutions.
Apply today and be eligible for a one-month sign-on bonus.*
*Terms & Conditions apply.
 
Design, build and optimize ETL/data pipelines for large-scale data operations
Develop and maintain platform components using Python and PySpark
Manage and enhance Data pipelines on Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory and Azure Synapse Analytics
Oversee data platform operations, troubleshooting and performance tuning
Implement DataOps practices, including CI/CD and Terraform automation
Validate and compare large data volumes to ensure data quality and accuracy
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, scalable data solutions
yeu_cau:
Strong hands-on experience in Data Engineering, ETL and data integration
Proven experience with Azure Data Factory and Databricks
Strong Python, PySpark, and SQL skills, with experience in Python OOP and ORMs
Deep understanding of Databricks features (e.g., Unity Catalog) and system integrations
Experience with DataOps, CI/CD pipelines and Terraform on Azure
Excellent troubleshooting, problem-solving and communication skills
Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks and deliver under tight deadlines
